teacher.alertIneq: Students frequently forget to reverse inequality symbols (≤ / ≥) when dividing by negative numbers.
teacher.recIneq: Focus on sign flip rules in linear inequality constraints.
teacher.alertSet: Misidentifying the complement of set union vs intersection in Venn diagrams.
teacher.recSet: Emphasize shaded region notation for n((A ∪ B)').
teacher.alertBase: Carrying digits incorrectly in non-decimal bases (specifically Base 8 and Base 2 addition).
teacher.recBase: Reinforce place value groups of 8 and 2.
